title: Scope catalog (named scopes + decision-profile archetypes)
$comment: The normative enumeration owned by dplaax.spec_draft (claims.catalog.single-owner, claims.catalog.enumerated). Named scopes and the three decision-profile archetypes with their required scope sets. Per-scope required-check definitions are filled incrementally; scopes marked p0-2-gated depend on the trusted-time / freshness / anchor decision (P0-2). The evidence-view.json `scope` enum inlines this set (no cross-file $ref) and must stay in sync.
$comment2: A catalog record: which scope set and which profile a claim contract pins.

scopeName.$comment: The named scope set (claims.scope.named). @1 is the initial version; the version suffix is part of the identity.

profileId.$comment: The three decision-profile archetypes (claims.profile.archetypes). A profileId is a distinct identity from a claimContractId (claims.contract.distinct-from-profile).

scopeNotes.$comment: SEMANTIC_EXECUTION@1 is outside the protocol's decision scope (adapters / audit infrastructure own it); a protocol verifier reports it UNSUPPORTED. TLOG_TRUSTED_TIME@1 and any freshness-bearing required-scope membership are p0-2-gated (their evaluation and profile membership are fixed by the P0-2 trusted-time / lifecycle-snapshot decision).
